title: Take or abandon quests in an existing recipe 3 world
description: The body of POST /world/quest. A playing session tells the world what its party did with an offer; the world does not invent it. `quest_id` is the hook id the `quests` block keys on, which only exists once the world has been advanced by at least one day. `day` defaults to the world clock's current day. Actions apply in request order, so a batch that takes and then abandons one quest ends abandoned.

actions.description: The same capacity bound advance-time puts on `resolutions`.

day.description: A day on the moon calendar, at or after founding year 0. Omitted means the world clock's current day. Taking an offer after its `expires_day` is refused: the world has already let it lapse.
